name: Replika

summary.text: Replika is a companion chatbot app operated by Luka, Inc. of San Francisco and released publicly in November 2017; its founder Eugenia Kuyda has said it grew out of a 2016 memorial bot built from the messages of her late friend Roman Mazurenko. In February 2023 Italy's Garante ordered Replika's processing of Italian users' data suspended over risks to minors and emotionally vulnerable people, and in April 2025 fined Luka 5 million euros.

facts.claim: Italy's Garante announced on February 3, 2023 that it had stopped the Replika chatbot from processing Italian users' data, citing too many risks for minors and emotionally fragile people.

facts.claim: On April 10, 2025 the Garante fined Replika's operator Luka Inc. 5 million euros and ordered corrective measures; the press release of May 19, 2025 also announced a new inquiry into the generative AI behind the service.

facts.claim: In July 2022 Mezha.Media reported that Replika's chatbot produced responses claiming it worked for the KGB and blaming the Ukrainian government for the Bucha killings, and described Khosla Ventures as the startup's largest investor.
